name: DUUMBI
install:
set -euo pipefail
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libcurl4-openssl-dev build-essential
rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal --no-self-update
rustup component add --toolchain stable rustfmt clippy
rustup default stable
cargo build --workspace
cargo build -p duumbi-studio --features ssr --bin studio
